thread:
ashley: Observed p95 CPU and latency spike on Dedicated pool us-west for long-context models after merge PR #2147, customers experiencing SLA breaches.

sam: Saw that too, p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms on seq > 2048. Affected kernels look like the fused-attn selector path.

deploy-bot: PR #2147 merged to main by @matt at 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z

lee: CI perf was green for unit/short-context workloads but we didn't run long-context perf in premerge, missed that test.

naomi: Uploading profiler output — here's the hot path, looks like kernel selector choosing 'matmul-slow' for inner layers under certain mem estimates.

ashley: paste logs

naomi: ```
2026-03-18 09:35:12 perf: model=model-x64 seq=4096 batch=2 selected_kernel=matmul-slow p95=430ms
2026-03-18 09:35:12 perf: fallback_kv_hits=low kv_evictions=high
```

sam: Interesting — KV cache eviction rate spiked which increases recompute and widens batching windows. Two mechanisms compounding.

matt: The merged heuristic changed: prefer single-op kernel if estimated intermediate memory > threshold. Looks like the estimator is off for long sequences.

lee: Can we quickly pin kernel selector to the legacy heuristic on Dedicated? Minimal hotfix to stop customer impact.

ashley: Also seeing increased queueing — batching heuristic inflates batch size which exacerbates latency tails.

ops-bot: Alert: customer acme-corp SLA breaches detected on dc-us-west, rolling incident created: INC-8792

naomi: Running binary revert test now, can patch selector to force 'matmul-opt' for seq>1024 for a quick mitigation.

sam: Let's try a canary with 1 node in the dedicated pool first and watch p95 + kv eviction metrics.

matt: I can push a hotpatch: set KERNEL_SELECTOR_OVERRIDE=matmul-opt and KERNEL_SCORE_SCALE=0.8, will start canary deploy in ~3m.

ashley: Thanks. If canary fixes, we should revert PR #2147 and open a follow-up to correct the cost model + add long-context perf gate to CI.

matt: Canary up @ 1794008400 — monitoring.

naomi: Canary p95 down to ~130ms, kv_evictions normalized. Marking as rollback candidate.

ashley: Proceed with rollback then open postmortem, include a mandatory perf regression test for seq>2048 in PR template. :exclamation:

lee: Filing rollback PR now.

ashley: Great, closing loop with ops + CS.
